Health, attack and drops below are read from the built behavior pack. Bosses have a boss bar and a second phase below half health; every boss gives **stars** (rank) and magic XP to everyone who fought it (the killer gets the most).

## Who fights whom

| Side | Members | Hunts |
|---|---|---|
| Clover Kingdom | Magic Knights, Ancient Constructs, the Travelling Merchant | all monsters (players only after being attacked) |
| Devil Host | Devils, the Archdevil, Dark Disciples, Imps, Devil Gates, Hellhounds, Mana Wraiths, the Fallen Captain, the Soul Puppeteer and its marionettes, Cultists, the Grimoire Devourer | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| Bandit Brotherhood | Bandits, Bandit Archers, Bandit Thieves, the Bandit King | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch, villagers |
| The Hive | Hive Drones, Hive Eggs, the Hive Queen | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch, villagers |
| Sea Raiders | Sea Raiders, Raider Captains, Phantom Raiders, the Phantom Galleon | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| Tidewatch Navy | Sentinels, Commodores, Marksmen | players with a bounty, pirates, devils, Dark Disciples, Rogue Mages |
| Rogue Mages | Rogue Mages (outlaws with real grimoires, levels 2-8), Shadow Assassins | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| The Witch Sisters | the Frost Witch and the Ember Witch | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| The restless dead | the Bone Dragon and the skeletons it calls | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |

Members of a side never hurt each other with magic. In War Table battles the armies only fight each other (and anyone who attacks them).

## Structures

* **Pirate outposts** - islands with palms, a tent, a dock, a campfire, a loot chest and a Bounty Board; appear out of sight while you sail over deep water.
* **Sunken wrecks** - two treasure chests (fruits, doubloons, maps) guarded by the Drowned.
* **Ancient dungeons** - form underground near explorers: a ruined entrance, a stairway, a corridor of **flame traps**, a pillared hall with a working Grimoire Altar, a treasure vault (ancient pages, squad robes, mana crystals, diamonds, treasure maps) and the Dungeon Guardian.
* **Magic Knight camps** - appear on open grassland near explorers: three tents with bedrolls around a campfire, benches, a lantern post, a **Mission Board**, a **Magic Forge** beside an armour stand (v0.8.0), a supply chest (mana crystals, cookies, bread, sometimes a contract, ancient page, amulet, robe, whistle or mana-steel ingots) and three knights on watch.

### Lairs (v0.7.5)

Lairs appear out of sight near explorers (never within 360 blocks of another structure) and suit the ground they stand on. The first time you open a lair's chest it counts towards the **Lair Raider** feat. Build one on the spot with `/scriptevent bc:lair hideout` (or `nest`, `shrine`).

| Lair | Where | Guards | Loot |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bandit hideout** | sand, red sand, terracotta, coarse dirt; sometimes grassland | a palisade, two shacks and a watchtower; 3 Bandits, 2 Bandit Archers, a Bandit Thief - and a 20% chance the **Bandit King** is at home | a stash chest (20-45 doubloons, gold, emeralds, bread, Mana Potions, Smoke Bombs, maybe a spell scroll) and a vault (40-90 doubloons, diamonds, a treasure map, an Elixir of Haste, spell scrolls, Shadow Silk; sometimes an amulet or a Bandit's Crown) |
| **Hive nest** | mud, moss, podzol, clay, mycelium; sometimes grassland | a honeycomb dome with 5 Hive Eggs and 3 Hive Drones - 12% chance of the **Hive Queen** | honeycomb, honey bottles, slime balls, mana crystals, Chitin Plates; sometimes a Greater Mana Potion, an amulet or Royal Jelly |
| **Cultist shrine** | grassland and forest | a ring of pillars around a crying-obsidian altar; 3 Cultists and 2 Imps | ancient pages, mana crystals, spell scrolls, an Elixir of Iron, Devil Hide, Arcane Thread; sometimes a Devil Heart, an amulet or a Forbidden Tome |

## Elite enemies (v0.7.5)

About **6%** of hostile spawns (half as many again during a Mana Eclipse) come as an **elite**: its name turns gold and says its trait, it has Health Boost III and Resistance, and a coloured spark floats over its head. Bosses, Hive Eggs, Devil Gates, summoned minions and anything with an owner are never elite. An elite drops **10-25 doubloons**, and maybe a **spell scroll** (40%), a **Mana Potion** (25%) or an **amulet** (8%). Defeating ten counts for the **Elite Hunter** feat.

| Trait | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Vampiric** | Heals itself for 30% of the damage it deals. |
| **Shielded** | A mana shield halves spell damage until three blows break it. |
| **Swift** | Fast, skilled and hard to hit. |
| **Explosive** | Bursts one second after it falls - get clear! |
| **Summoner** | Calls two lesser copies of itself every 15 seconds. |
| **Arcane** | Casts a spell from a random grimoire every 8 seconds. |
| **Frenzied** | Below half health it gains Strength II and Speed. |
